title: Can I POUND Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess with hard drawbacks: goal three wins; wins games 1-3 and draws a bonus 4th game by threefold repetition (first draw ever in the series).
rules: Standard setup; each player gets one secret random drawback (with hard drawbacks enabled); opponent's drawback is revealed after the game.
No check/checkmate: kings can be captured; moving into check is legal; capturing the enemy king wins.
If your drawback makes you have no legal moves / you violate a lose-condition drawback, you lose.
The site highlights moves your drawback requires.

Drawbacks seen: Scent of Blood: you can't make non-capturing moves with pieces that could capture; (opponent) you can't move a non-pawn piece adjacent to another of your non-pawn pieces, and you can't castle; (opponent) you can't move onto the rim; Rising-rank restriction: can't be on the first rank, then second, then third... every six moves (as described); As long as you have a knight, you can only capture with knights; Your king can only make moves that place it adjacent to your queen and can't move if you have no queen / your queen can only make moves that place it adjacent to your king; Fischer Random: on or before move 20 all your remaining non-pawn pieces must be on your home row on a square they could not have started on (frame); Boxing with Shadows: when your opponent moves a piece, if you can move to the square they moved from, you must (frame)
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent loses by drawback or time. Video goal: 3 wins (achieved; bonus game drawn).
